selectedPages.laneReason: Four typed-input questions, second-wrong reveal, host-selected feedback, independent coaching clocks, device text restoration and source-authored fourth-answer/outro repair require a bounded maintained state machine.

definitions.en: A number line is a way to order real numbers by their size. Numbers increase to the right and decrease to the left.
definitions.es: La recta numérica es una manera de ordenar los números reales por su tamaño. Los números aumentan hacia la derecha y disminuyen hacia la izquierda.

definitions.en: The solution is what you get when you have solved the problem. For example: 5 is the solution to the problem 3 + 2.
definitions.es: La solución (o respuesta) es lo que se obtiene una vez resuelto un problema. Por ejemplo, 5 es la solución de la suma 2 + 3.

audioPlan.sourceAlignment: Unchanged native MP3,22050 mono,1673 latency. Main intro1..542 holds at the source question. Each source feedback runs its own clock; first wrong closes to retry, second wrong closes then Next_Quest2..42. Each correct feedback ends into Next_Quest2..42. Answers1..3 hold. Explicit question4 repair plays main549..604 and stops. No audio loops, padding or resampling; native nodes retire on pause/replay/navigation.
audioPlan.seedPolicy: Bounded indexMI random3 wrong/random4 right selection, mapped to deterministic uint32 seed plus attempt ordinal; not original random parity.

practice.prompt: Solve the problem. Click the text box, type your solution , and then click the Enter button. To try another problem, click New Problem.

help.text: To add two integers, mentally think of them on a number line . Jump the number of units from zero for the first number. Then jump the number of units for the second number from the first number.
help.productAdaptation: Pause playback and gate inputs during Help; restore the same question and typed text on close.

practice.wrongText: Remember to add each unit cube, tens rod to find the solution.

actions.replay: Reset all four questions, typed input, attempt counters, branch seed cursor, answer/reveal outcomes, help/glossary, every audio domain and main1.
